target_customer: Crypto users and web3 projects on Farcaster who launch and discover projects
problem: Crypto projects lacked a simple community channel to launch and be discovered, and consumers lacked easy NFT payments and curation tools.
business_model: Consumer crypto apps, no revenue model found
product_category: Consumer crypto apps (Launchcaster, Frameboard, Launcher Actions, Maindrop)

exit.reason: Launchcaster product acquired by Orange DAO; Launcher Labs listed as inactive

technical_complexity.rationale: Small consumer web3 apps built on Farcaster and smart contracts; standard engineering with some novel protocol work.

defensibility.rationale: Launch channel value depended on Farcaster community attention; code was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No evidence found of incumbents copying; Launchcaster was bought by Orange DAO (date unknown).

market_need_then: Crypto consumer app interest was high in early 2021, with NFT activity driving demand for payment and curation tools; no direct figures found.

brand_strength.rationale: Launchcaster had a clear tagline ('Product Hunt or Launch YC of Web3' per YC page) but no brand press found.

pivots.why: Not stated by sources; inferred only from the YC product list.

outcome_analysis: Launcher Labs built several consumer crypto apps in sequence rather than one focused product. Launchcaster, the Farcaster based launch channel released on Product Hunt in October 2022, was acquired by Orange DAO, while the company is listed as inactive. The cause of wind down is not public, and the pivot_failed label reflects only the visible spread across four apps.
notes: Competitor list empty: no dated rival to Launchcaster found near the 2021 batch (it launched in 2022). The $500K seed rests on a single aggregator (VCBacked) listing it for Launchcaster, dated 2024-03 which seems late; attribution to Launcher Labs is unverified. Orange DAO acquisition date year unknown (Paragraph post dated Sept 30 per snippet). Dealroom entry named Launcher Labs belongs to another company. Company website field empty; no site fetched. Founder education and prior employers not found. Exit conflict: directory says Inactive while exit records the Launchcaster product acquisition by Orange DAO (YC page); the company itself is inactive.
